question: 我晚上一直刷亮屏手机，到了床上还是不困。资料能解释一种可能的影响吗？能认定我的情况就是手机造成的吗？
answer:
资料确实能解释一种可能的影响：夜间明亮的灯光会干扰褪黑素分泌，让入睡变得更困难，而手机屏幕正是这类光源之一[H7:EveningLight]。所以“床上刷亮屏手机、躺下还不困”这个组合，在生理机制上是有合理联系的。

但不能据此认定你的情况就是手机造成的。同一份资料明确说明，这不能证明某个人的入睡偏晚就是由屏幕引起的[H7:EveningLight]。要判断具体原因，还需要知道你的上床时间、关灯时间、实际入睡时刻、白天活动量、咖啡因摄入，以及最近几晚的睡眠记录；这些信息目前都还没有。

如果想减少这个可能的影响，可以试试在睡前留出一小时做安静活动，并减少使用亮屏设备[H2:WindDown]。这只是一个可尝试的调整方向，并不等于已经确认了你的原因。

retrieved_evidence.title: NIH/NHLBI ? Your Sleep/Wake Cycle
retrieved_evidence.scope: General circadian physiology; no universal bedtime
retrieved_evidence.text: Bright artificial light late in the evening can interfere with melatonin release and make falling asleep harder. Screens are possible sources of this light. This does not prove that a particular person's late sleep onset was caused by a screen, or establish one compulsory bedtime for everyone.

retrieved_evidence.title: NIH/NHLBI · Healthy Sleep Habits
retrieved_evidence.scope: Adult sleep habits and shift-work guidance
retrieved_evidence.text: Use the hour before bed for quiet activities, reducing bright screens and intense exercise. Relaxation or a warm bath may help. Keep the bedroom cool, dark and quiet; spend time outdoors and be active during the day.

retrieved_evidence.title: NIH/NHLBI · Insomnia Treatment
retrieved_evidence.scope: Insomnia treatment education; no individualized prescription
retrieved_evidence.text: Stimulus control links bed with sleep: go to bed when sleepy, leave bed if unable to sleep, and return when sleepy. Use bed for sleep rather than prolonged wakeful activities. This is one component of CBT-I, not proof of a diagnosis.

retrieved_evidence.title: NHS · Insomnia
retrieved_evidence.text: For difficulty sleeping, keep a regular getting-up time, go to bed when sleepy and allow a relaxing hour before bed. A dark, quiet, comfortable bedroom can help. After a poor night, avoid sleeping in to compensate. For insomnia, NHS advises avoiding daytime naps; this is more restrictive than general short-nap guidance and should not be presented as a universal ban for every sleeper.
